Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Insight Enterprises, Inc. is a Fortune 500 Solutions Integrator helping organizations accelerate transformation by unlocking the power of people and technology. We architect, build and manage solutions for complex IT environments to deliver outcomes that contribute to our clients' success.
Our portfolio of digital transformation services includes deep expertise in cloud, data, AI, cybersecurity and intelligent edge. These services, augmented by Insight's longstanding relationships with 6,000+ technology partners across the globe, enable us to deliver the right technical solutions quickly and effectively. We're rated as a Great Place to Work, a Forbes Best Employer for Diversity and a Forbes World's Top Female-Friendly Company.
We're seeking an experienced Senior DevOps Engineer to join our team. The candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining reliable, secure, and scalable cloud infrastructure for our applications while promoting automation, infrastructure as code, and operational best practices.
 Key Responsibilities
Design and implement infrastructure solutions primarily on AWS using IaC tools (Terraform)
Deploy, manage, and scale containerized and platform-managed applications on AWS ECS and AWS Elastic Beanstalk
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitHub Actions
Configure and optimize content delivery and edge security using CloudFront, AWS WAF, and AWS Shield
Support Firebase-based application backends and integrate them with existing cloud infrastructure
Drive automation initiatives to reduce manual interventions across projects
Optimize system performance, cost, and reliability, and implement monitoring and alerting solutions
Collaborate with application teams to increase their operational independence
Create and maintain documentation and runbooks for critical systems
 Required Technical Skills
5+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or similar roles
Strong experience with AWS services (ECS, Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, Lambda, S3, RDS, IAM)
Hands-on experience with CloudFront (CDN) and edge security (AWS WAF, AWS Shield)
Proficiency with infrastructure as code (Terraform)
Container orchestration experience (Docker, AWS ECS)
Expertise in CI/CD implementation (Jenkins, GitHub Actions)
Experience with Firebase (Authentication, Firestore, Hosting, Cloud Functions)
Working knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
Strong scripting skills (Python, Bash)
Experience with monitoring and logging solutions (CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana)
 Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting high-traffic, multi-tier web and microservice architectures
Knowledge of serverless architectures and their operational challenges
Experience hardening edge and application security (WAF rules, DDoS mitigation with Shield)
Experience with cost optimization across AWS and GCP
Experience implementing SLI/SLO frameworks and performance metrics
Familiarity with secrets management and security scanning tools
Experience with change management processes and risk assessment
AWS Solutions Architect Associate
Terraform Associate
 Working Environment
Candidate will support multiple environments (DEV, QA, STG, PROD)
Support for platforms based on different architectural approaches: containerized (ECS), platform-managed (Elastic Beanstalk), serverless, and Firebase-backed applications
Primary focus on AWS infrastructure, with secondary use of GCP
Automation, documentation, and standardization practices
